name: Die That We May Live On
source:
A man walks with destructive intentions towards a graveyard, but lady luck must be rolling dices for him badly. A witness may abridge him from his path.

[From [url=https://peppekz.itch.io/die-that-we-may-live-on]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个男人带着破坏性的意图走向墓地，但幸运女神一定对他掷骰子很糟糕。目击者可能会缩短他的道路。

[来自[url=https://peppekz.itch.io/die-that-we-may-live-on]itch.io[/url]]
